name: sol9-composer-final-review
goal: Composer captions and approval blockers stay readable at every viewport

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Visual-plan captions overlap the textarea; unapproved Change lacks its blocker. Committed captures reproduce both at all three viewports.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing catalog cases checked text presence and disabled Send, not caption spacing or a visible approval reason. Strengthened those same viewport cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record 47e6f96eb64a8771a634d332e0e8e51254d12ec6fcbefcc7a508cb1c0cd23835 failed all six frozen Composer cases at a130093e15: caption overlap and absent approval reason.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 07c9d3406e separates the caption and reuses shared Notice for unapproved Change. Tests and fixture inputs remain unchanged from red.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 35f376dd27587d8fe71680879054a043eb09c24eed3be62e5f141c45aaba5005 passes all six unchanged cases at07c9d3406e. Inspected all six original images.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
